implemented: Common signal adapter routes named actions and cost-itemized NetAlpha forecasts through the shared target portfolio optimizer.
Expected net alpha remains separate from the allocator's covariance risk penalty.
Additions below the per-horizon net-alpha hurdle abstain; SELL signals carry a negative target score.
Existing positions require explicit observations, horizons must match, and residual cash is explicit.
Output is labeled research-only and does not submit orders.

tests.result: 9 passed (exit code 0); Ruff and mypy passed.

limitations: All strategy adapters and the forward paper session are not yet wired to this common allocator.
Forecast calibration, versioned covariance and production universe alignment remain unverified.
